6f9c4ea Edit README.md - update after end of project
# Application images [necessary]
# Pin release or commit tags in production instead of using latest.
WEB_IMAGE=registry.opencode.de/sh/digitalhub-sh/landesprogramm-offene-innovationen/kommunalenergie/gitlab-profile:latest
IOTHUBSH_ADAPTER_IMAGE=registry.opencode.de/sh/digitalhub-sh/landesprogramm-offene-innovationen/kommunalenergie/gitlab-profile/iothubsh-adapter:latest

# DSNs if Sentry should be used. If backend and frontend use the same DSN, SENTRY_DSN can be set.
# Otherwise set SENTRY_BACKEND_DSN and SENTRY_FRONTEND_DSN with the DSNs for backend and frontend.
# [optional]
SENTRY_DSN=
SENTRY_BACKEND_DSN=
SENTRY_FRONTEND_DSN=

# Database [necessary]
DB_HOST=postgres
DB_PORT=5432
DB_DATABASE=yii2_db
DB_USER=yii2_user
DB_PASSWORD=userpassword
INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD=change-me

# Reverse proxy / TLS (Traefik + Let's Encrypt) [necessary]
APP_DOMAIN=example.com
LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL=
TRAEFIK_LOG_LEVEL=INFO
TRAEFIK_HTTP_PORT=80
TRAEFIK_HTTPS_PORT=443
# Controls middleware on HTTP router:
# - yii-https-redirect (default): redirect HTTP -> HTTPS
# - yii-noop: no redirect (for local development)
TRAEFIK_HTTP_ROUTER_MIDDLEWARES=yii-https-redirect
# Set to empty value to disable Let's Encrypt cert issuance for local development.
TRAEFIK_TLS_CERTRESOLVER=letsencrypt

# App names and URLs [necessary]
APP_FRONTEND_NAME=ke_frontend
APP_BACKEND_NAME=ke_backend
APP_BACKEND_HOME_URL=/administration
APP_BACKEND_BASE_URL=/administration/
APP_FRONTEND_SESSION_NAME=ke-frontend
APP_BACKEND_SESSION_NAME=ke-backend

# Security [necessary]
FRONTEND_COOKIE_VALIDATION_KEY=frontend_cookie
BACKEND_COOKIE_VALIDATION_KEY=backend_cookie
# Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32
API_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY=
# Password for the admin user protecting /administration/docs/ with HTTP Basic Auth.
SWAGGER_HTTP_AUTH_PASSWORD=change-me
ENABLE_CSRF_VALIDATION_FRONTEND=false
ENABLE_CSRF_VALIDATION_BACKEND=false

# Email params [optional]
ADMIN_EMAIL=
SUPPORT_EMAIL=
SENDER_EMAIL=
SENDER_NAME=KommunalEnergie Mailer
PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRE=3600

# Mailer [optional]
MAILER_SCHEME=smtp
MAILER_HOST=
MAILER_USER=
MAILER_PASSWORD=
MAILER_PORT=465
MAILER_USE_FILE_TRANSPORT=true

# Initial UI defaults [optional]
# These values are used until they are overridden in Administration > System.
VITE_APP_TITLE=KommunalEnergie
VITE_APP_SUBTITLE_FRONTEND=KommunalEnergie
VITE_APP_SUBTITLE_BACKEND=KommunalEnergie Administration
VITE_FOOTER_TEXT=KommunalEnergie
VITE_FOOTER_LINK=https://viakom.de/

# iothubsh adapter upstream target [optional]
# Keep http://web for Docker-internal access, or set a full external URL if needed.
IOTHUBSH_TARGET_BASE_URL=http://web
